description: This file contains utility functions for creating shared image video frames, including RGBA, I420, and NV12 formats, for testing purposes within the media rendering component. It manages shared images via GPU Mailboxes and handles their lifecycle with destruction callbacks.

methods.name: CreateSharedImageFrame
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame from shared images (mailboxes) with specified format, size, and synchronization token, and sets up destruction callback.

methods.name: CreateSharedImageRGBAFrame
methods.description: Generates a shared RGBA VideoFrame with test pattern pixels, creates shared image, and wraps it into a VideoFrame.

methods.name: CreateSharedImageI420Frame
methods.description: Creates a shared I420 VideoFrame with test pattern YUV data, using three shared images for Y, U, and V planes.

methods.name: CreateSharedImageNV12Frame
methods.description: Creates a shared NV12 VideoFrame with test pattern data, using two shared images for Y and UV planes.
